name: Barbados Boat Trips by BluBel Watersports
summary: Captain Damo, born and raised in Barbados, runs snorkelling, fishing and coastal boat trips on BluBel I and BluBel II, a two-storey glass-bottom boat. Families are welcome, children five and under go free, and refreshments, life jackets and snorkel gear are provided.
standouts: BluBel II, a two-storey glass-bottom boat, launched January 2023
Children five years old or under go free on all trips
Refreshments, life jackets and snorkel equipment provided
Bespoke packages built with the captain on request

trips.title: Snorkeling
trips.summary: A boat trip to snorkel with reef fish, with a chance of swimming with turtles and stingrays at spots the captain knows. A lunch or dinner package can be added at extra cost.
highlights: Chance to swim with turtles and stingrays
Snorkel equipment, life jackets and refreshments provided
Optional lunch or dinner package at additional cost
Children five years old or under go free

trips.checkNotes: Price is listed on the pricing page as 'Turtle and snorkeling trips' in both BBD and USD; priceFrom uses the USD figure. The services page mentions a lunch or dinner add-on 'see pricing page', but the pricing page gives no price for it. Duration, departure times and departure point are not stated. Inclusions come from the About page, which applies them to all trips. Booking by phone, WhatsApp, email, text or contact form only.

trips.title: Coastal tour
trips.summary: A slower trip along the Barbados coastline by boat, taking in quiet spots and the celebrity houses that can only be seen from the water. A lunch or dinner package can be added at extra cost.
highlights: Views of coastal homes only visible from the sea
Optional lunch or dinner package at additional cost
Children five years old or under go free

trips.title: Fishing trips
trips.summary: Fishing trips set up around the group, for first-timers through to experienced anglers. Priced by the hour for a party of up to five, and the captain can fillet the catch for guests to take back for dinner.
highlights: Priced per hour for a party of up to five
Catch can be filleted on board to take home
Children five years old or under go free

checkNotes: The site never states where trips leave from. Town 'Holetown' comes from the operator list (base Holetown Beach, St. James) and a gallery caption that mentions a manta ray 'just off Holetown'; confirm with the operator. No online booking: phone, WhatsApp, email, text or contact form only, and the site shows no wa.me link. The site looks active: the pricing page was last modified 18 Aug 2026 according to the site's own WordPress API and the gallery has 2025 photos. The header logo slot holds a cropped boat photo rather than a logo.
